_note: One House, WP4: the twelve people found in the town (sim.rescue, scripts/town/rescue.gd). They are met in the order of the generator's rescue spots, near to far. A role must be one of assets/data/recruits.json's roles (their skills and weapon come from it); a station is one of the base layout's (bench, builders, radio, watch, infirmary); a pack is what they bring (stock keys).

choices.stay: Stay here, I will come back

why.no_base: You have no house to take them to yet
why.no_bed: There is no bed for them
why.gifted: You have already given them something

lines.come: All right. I will find the house.

contact: Radio check. Can you hear me?
I am on the set now. Say something.
Got the radio. Does it do anything else?

survivors.name: Abe Tanner
survivors.hiding: Screwed a wardrobe to the wall and sat behind it
survivors.line: I heard the shots. Then it went quiet. Is it quiet?
survivors.come: Give me a minute for my tools. I will find you.
survivors.stay: I am not going anywhere. I have a bolt and a lot of practice.
survivors.gift: That is more than I would have offered you.
survivors.blocked: Not with them in here. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Priya Nair
survivors.hiding: A stockroom, a bed made of cardboard
survivors.line: Do not open that bag. Everything in it is counted.
survivors.come: Let me take the labels with me. People will ask what is what.
survivors.stay: Go and finish what you were doing. I will be here, counting.
survivors.gift: Thank you. I will write it down.
survivors.blocked: I can hear them in the next room. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Joel Brandt
survivors.hiding: A loft, the ladder pulled up after him
survivors.line: I could have shot the last one from up here. I did not want to teach the others the way.
survivors.come: Fine. I will bring the rifle and my own boxes.
survivors.stay: I will keep watch from here. Do not take long.
survivors.gift: Shells? You should not have. Thanks.
survivors.blocked: Two of them are still down there. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Fenn Haddad
survivors.hiding: The meter cupboard, the door held shut with a belt
survivors.line: Is the power on where you are? No. I did not think so. I can still help.
survivors.come: Give me a torch and a roof and I will do the rest.
survivors.stay: I will be in the cupboard. It is quite comfortable.
survivors.gift: Batteries would have been better. This will do.
survivors.blocked: Something is breathing outside the door. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Tess Moreno
survivors.hiding: Under the stairs with a bag of rice and a bad temper
survivors.line: Nine days of rice and salt. Tell me you have anything else.
survivors.come: Get me to a stove and I will make it worth your while.
survivors.stay: Come back with a pan. A proper one.
survivors.gift: Real food. Give me a second.
survivors.blocked: Do not make me walk past that. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Mara Lindqvist
survivors.hiding: The pantry, the door barred with a mop
survivors.line: I thought I was the last one on this street. I counted. It is a habit.
survivors.come: I will bring my notes. I have written down everyone I saw.
survivors.stay: I will keep counting. Come back when you can.
survivors.gift: Thank you. That is one less thing to count.
survivors.blocked: Not past them. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Ruben Szabo
survivors.hiding: The garage, under a car that does not run
survivors.line: I would say hello, but the last thing that came in here was not friendly.
survivors.come: I will carry my own tools. Do not offer to help.
survivors.stay: I am fixing the van. Come back when it is done.
survivors.gift: That goes in the toolbox. Thanks.
survivors.blocked: Not with those in the garage. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Ines Calloway
survivors.hiding: A landing, a lamp and a bag of dressings
survivors.line: I heard a lot of shooting. Was anyone hurt? I can do something about that.
survivors.come: Let me finish this. Then I am yours.
survivors.stay: I will be here. Somebody is bound to need me.
survivors.gift: Thank you. It goes with the dressings.
survivors.blocked: I cannot go that way. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Gus Okafor
survivors.hiding: The back of a minibus in his own driveway
survivors.line: I know every road out of here. They all end the same way. Is there one that does not?
survivors.come: Somewhere with a wall is a start. Let me lock up.
survivors.stay: I will be in the bus. Honk if you need me. Actually, do not.
survivors.gift: That will get me through the evening.
survivors.blocked: They are by the door. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Dot Kessler
survivors.hiding: Behind the counter, the shutter down, the lights off
survivors.line: Everything in here is for sale. I am joking. Mostly.
survivors.come: I will take the till. Never mind why.
survivors.stay: I have stock to count. Come back when you can.
survivors.gift: I would call that a fair trade.
survivors.blocked: Not with them in the shop. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Ollie Park
survivors.hiding: Under a desk, in a room with a view of the street
survivors.line: Sorry. I have been quiet for so long I forgot how to be anything else.
survivors.come: Yes. Yes, please. Do I bring my bag? I will bring my bag.
survivors.stay: Okay. I will be here. Quietly.
survivors.blocked: Please do not open that door. Get them out first.

survivors.name: Nell Abara
survivors.hiding: The back bedroom, a chair under the handle, a rifle across her knees
survivors.line: Eleven years of night shifts. This one is the longest. Nobody has relieved me.
survivors.come: Good. I will take the next shift.
survivors.stay: I will hold here until you are ready. I am good at that.
survivors.gift: It is not much. I will take it.
survivors.blocked: I have one eye on the door. Get them out first.
